newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Conrail 1997 estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Conrail 1997 estimate raised.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Friday it raised its 1997 earnings estimate for Conrail Inc to $5.50 a share from $5.35 to reflect an anticipated improvement in the company's operating ratio.

-- Gruntal said it remained neutral on Conrail, which will soon be acquired by CSX Corp in a deal worth $115 a share. Conrail's first-quarter earnings of $0.70 a share were above Gruntal's estimate and revenues improved 1.9 percent to $906 million on a 4.9-percent traffic gain, Gruntal said.
-- Its shares were unchanged Friday at $113-3/4.
